name: smwmusic-castlevania-rise-of-the-vampire-killer-vampire-killer-remix
title: Castlevania - Rise of the Vampire Killer ~ Vampire Killer (Remix)
description:
𝕯𝖎𝖊, 𝖒𝖔𝖓𝖘𝖙𝖊𝖗! 𝖄𝖔𝖚 𝖉𝖔𝖓'𝖙 𝖇𝖊𝖑𝖔𝖓𝖌 𝖎𝖓 𝖙𝖍𝖎𝖘 𝖜𝖔𝖗𝖑𝖉!

The first stage of Castlevania 1 that became one of the three definitive theme songs of the Castlevania franchise. A bit more intensive than the original version, but that's how I like it. It also has an ending similar to that the of Castlevania: Rondo of Blood version of this song... or is it...

This song could fit dark stages, castles, intense ghost houses, and maybe even factories if you're crazy enough to use them in those levels.

Note: There's a READ ME!!.txt file with the sample group necessary for this song to work. All you need to do is copy what's inside and place it into the Addmusic_sample groups.txt file or else an error will come up when you try to export this into your romhack. The Thunder SFX is not compatible with this song.
